results.title: AI gone wild: let's discuss times AI got it really wrong - Ask a Manager
results.content: **•** I would like to shout-out the AI transcription tool at my old job that took notes at a meeting evaluating applicants for a job…and then automatically emailed said notes to the entire company AND to the candidates under discussion. We banned AI notetakers at the next meeting, not only because of the “is everyone here a human for quorum” confusion but also because their notetaker e-mailed all of us the transcription, which was wrong on pretty much every point of business in the summary and shouldn’t have had all of our e-mail addresses anyway (none of us work for the same organizations, so it wasn’t an internal tool from our company). When I had an AI tool briefly transcribe a group meeting, then email the summary before I kicked it – got some of the context right (we were chatting about the AI note taker and the tone was curious), when we talked about some world events (the south korean martial law episode at the time – one of the participants was originally from south korea and had just been there) I very much remember it transcribed us as having discussed “martial arts”.
